## dbecc530afd0

**A1 — Reproduced validator-domain defect.** The source says `n_rects` is valid
only for `1..2` and its invariant says a lawful input has one or two complete
yellow-corner rectangles.  A constructed 18×18 input with three disjoint 3×3
rectangles nevertheless returns `[]` from `self_check`, while
`observe_overrides` reports `n_rects: 3`.  This means the task validator can
admit examples outside the documented generator domain and therefore cannot
certify that the one/two-rectangle contract was enforced.
